title: Seeing Why: Exact Evidence Maps for Quantum and Optical Image Classifiers
abstract: arXiv:2611.01993v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: When an image classifier decides, we can usually only estimate why. For quantum and all-optical classifiers that act linearly on amplitude-encoded pictures up to the measurement, with no trained classical network before or after them, each class's Born probability above its no-information share, $P_g - b_g$, splits exactly into contributions of the encoded amplitudes, shown as Born evidence maps (BEM). The split itself follows from known results on quadratic forms: with the transmitted light held fixed, it is what Integrated Gradients from a zero baseline and the Shapley value give. translated_title: 看见为什么：量子与光学图像分类器的精确证据图
translated_abstract: 当图像分类器做出决策时，我们通常只能估计其原因是为何。对于在测量之前对振幅编码图像进行线性作用、且前后不含已训练经典网络的量子分类器与全光分类器，每个类别高于其无信息基线的玻恩概率 $P_g - b_g$ 可以被精确分解为各编码振幅的贡献，并以玻恩证据图（BEM）的形式呈现。这种分解本身源自二次型的已知结果：在透射光保持固定的情况下，它正是从零基线出发的积分梯度与沙普利值所给出的结果。本文的贡献在于提出了一种在执行分类的实际硬件上测量该分解的方法：在量子芯片上通过类别概率、或在仿真中通过透镜平台上的相机帧来测量，无需梯度电路，也无需向后发送光；生成一张 $g\times g$ 的证据图只需 $1 + 2g^2$ 次运行。删除证据值最高的5%像素会使准确率从73%降至9%（……）
tldr: 本文提出玻恩证据图（BEM），无需梯度电路和反向光路，即可在量子芯片或光学硬件上仅用 $1+2g^2$ 次运行，将量子与全光图像分类器各类别的玻恩概率精确分解为逐像素的贡献。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Born Evidence Maps (BEM), which exactly decompose each class's Born probability of quantum and all-optical image classifiers into per-pixel contributions, measurable on the classifying hardware itself in only 1+2g² runs, with no gradient circuits and no light sent backwards.
